snippet.title: Echo Weaver trailer | Thinky Direct 2025
snippet.description:
A time loop metroidBRAINia where time is your best resource and secrets are your only upgrades. You're the last of the Weavers, a remnant of a ruined society trapped in a glitching time loop. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

This is a brand new exclusive trailer for Echo Weaver, from Moonlight Kids and Akupara Games.

Echo Weaver in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/echo-weaver/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184080/Echo_Weaver/

https://thinkgames.com/direct/
